other_failure_modes.name: Feature encoding before splitting (Data Leakage)
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes distribution-dependent statistics (like frequency encoding) on the concatenated train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features, leading to overly optimistic validation scores and potential overfitting.

summary: The agent successfully implements a cross-validated ensemble of tree-based regressors with basic feature engineering. However, the solution has critical flaws: it computes frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets (causing data leakage), ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a randomized split, neglects data cleaning, and uses a naive equal-weight average for its ensemble.
